text: Consumer discretionary spending remains stable or grows over the next 1-2 years.

condition: A recession, rising unemployment, or inflation reduces disposable income, causing sales to fall.

text: No major tariff increases on imported outdoor gear from China or Vietnam.

condition: New US tariffs raise input costs by 10-25%, compressing margins unless AOUT raises prices (risking demand).

text: Key retail partnerships (Walmart, Bass Pro) continue and do not consolidate or drop AOUT.

condition: A major retailer drops AOUT or shifts to private-label alternatives, cutting revenue by 20%+.

text: The recent earnings beat and '2027 growth reset' narrative is credible and not a one-time event.

condition: Forward guidance disappoints or Q1 2027 sales show deceleration, reversing the stock's momentum.

statement: AOUT stock will trade below $10 within 12 months as consumer spending softens and tariff risks materialize, reversing the recent spike.
resolutionCriterion: Stock price closes below $10 on any day within 12 months from today.

statement: AOUT will report lower-than-expected fiscal Q1 2027 revenue (due Nov 2026) as retail orders normalize post pull-forward.
resolutionCriterion: Actual Q1 2027 revenue misses consensus by >5% or guidance cut.
